adapter_contract.source_support: 180x360 cell-centered global grid; values are not promoted to higher resolution

aArray.halo: nearest source ocean cell by deterministic periodic 8-neighbor geodesic extension with stable source-cell tie order; explicitly numerical interpolation support

cArray.conversion: m / 1000 because OrbData multiplies cArray by 1000

explicit_domain.classification: never derived from interpolated age or plate identity

continental_total_lithosphere.mechanism: explicit total-thickness grid; Assign initializes thickM as total lithosphere minus thickC, then applies source bounds and downstream consistency correction

serialization.header: x1 dx x2 then y1 dy y2; counts derived by OrbData
serialization.array_rows: NumPy south-to-north source reversed to OrbData north-to-south row order

projection.method: existing R6 canonical cell-to-FEG mesh/provider projection
projection.lineage: incident source-cell lineage retained per node
projection.unknown: preserved; mixed categorical boundary support remains unknown

shellset_source_generalization.mode_activation: all-or-nothing presence of per-model fort_<model>.15 and fort_<model>.16; neither means stock, both means ARCANA, one means fatal failure
shellset_source_generalization.unit_15: explicit physical_crust_domain_id categorical grid; ID 1 selects ocean, IDs 2..6 select continental structure
shellset_source_generalization.unit_16: continental_reference_lithosphere_thickness_m as requested TOTAL lithosphere structure; requested thickM starts as interpolated total minus thickC
shellset_source_generalization.categorical_lookup: nearest grid cell, deterministic half-cell tie behavior; domain values never bilinearly interpolated
shellset_source_generalization.stock_sArray: unchanged stock read and delta_ts inversion when ARCANA pair absent; not read in ARCANA mode
shellset_source_generalization.zero_elevation: exact zero bypasses ETOPO fallback in global OrbData5 needE scan and local Assign needE only when explicit pair is open
shellset_source_generalization.downstream_consistency: existing geotherm, cooling_curvature, chemical_delta_rho and correction logic continues after requested total-to-mantle conversion
shellset_source_generalization.inputsetup_staging: INPUT/ARCANA_DOMAIN.grd and INPUT/ARCANA_TOTAL_LITHOSPHERE_M.grd are an all-or-none source pair; InputSetup copies them to .15/.16 and omits .12 in ARCANA mode; absent pair stages stock DataFiles(6) as .12

synthetic_fixture.assign_result: requested total 135 km minus 35 km crust initializes 100 km mantle; ARCANA continental output invariant to synthetic sArray while stock output changes
synthetic_fixture.diagnostic: non-isostasy warning is test-fixture-parameter behavior, not T0 physical evidence

first_fair_attempt.failure: qualification script overrode FC=nvfortran, bypassing mpifort and leaving ShellSetMain without mpif.h include configuration

models_comparison.method: keyed by global model ID; row order ignored; ThID excluded as MPI scheduling metadata; columns 3+ compared exactly with Decimal; no tolerance

shellset_source_generalization.shellset_main_partial_pair_gate: immediately after InputSetup(ThID,ModNum,OD,DirName) and before OpenInput/OpenOutput/OrbData5; existing AEF/non-AEF FatalError check calls MPI_Abort
shellset_source_generalization.stock_regression: mpiexec -n 10 --map-by ppr:3:numa:PE=5 --bind-to core --report-bindings ./ShellSet.exe -Iter 4 -InOpt List -Dir RUN_DIR -GM 5,SSR,GV,SD,SA,FSR; exact Models.txt equality at reported precision
shellset_source_generalization.expected_stock_behavior: unchanged when complete explicit ARCANA input pair is absent
shellset_source_generalization.expected_arcana_behavior: domain grid controls ocean/continental branch independently of interpolated age; requested total lithosphere is converted to mantle component by subtracting crust; complete FEG elevation accepted at exact zero; no ETOPO fallback

models_comparison.method: exact fields from column 3 onward keyed by column 1 global model ID; column 2 ThID excluded; row ordering ignored; duplicate IDs rejected; exact set of 9 IDs required; no tolerance

models_parser_correction_pending_fair_re.global_model_id: integer column 1; exact required set 1..9; duplicates rejected
models_parser_correction_pending_fair_re.thid: column 2 ignored as MPI scheduling metadata
models_parser_correction_pending_fair_re.comparison: exact Decimal equality for numeric fields and exact string equality for nonnumeric fields in columns 3 onward, keyed by model ID; row order ignored; no tolerance
